# Part I - Platform packaging notes

<!-- Generated from agent_engine_manual.md by scripts/build_claude_plugin.py. Edit the manual and rebuild; do not edit this file by hand. -->

<a id="i-01"></a>
## I-01. Everything ships inside the strategy file

There is no shared `backtestloop_runtime` module importable from strategy code. Any canonical kernel (Part E), helper base class (C-04), or utility the strategy needs must be **pasted into `strategy.py` itself**, verbatim and unrenamed. Experiment file overrides are separate files with the same rule - each needs its own complete imports and helpers.

<a id="i-02"></a>
## I-02. Dependencies

The runtime ships `backtrader` (pinned fork), open-source `vectorbt`, `pandas`, `numpy`, `numba`, and the standard scientific stack. The packages rule in SKILL.md lists the full set. Extras need a `requirements.txt`, which works only where the server allows extra packages. Native-library packages (TA-Lib) cannot be installed - use the documented custom implementations instead.

<a id="i-03"></a>
## I-03. Latency and caching

Numba first-use compilation is a platform concern (workers prewarm common kernels). Do not add `cache=True` to `@njit` functions in strategy files (no stable file locator in the sandbox - see [G-10](manual-g-verification-repair.md#g-10) `NUMBA_CACHE_LOCATOR`), and do not restructure strategy code around import latency.
